name: Southwest

evidence.claim: Rarely measures anything. The most forgiving airline we track.

override.reason: Structural outlier. An LCC by cost base but a legacy carrier by baggage policy: free checked bags, the largest cabin allowance we track (61x41x25), and no gate sizers. The business-model prior predicts 7 and is wrong here for a documented reason.

research_scope: Standard adult cabin/personal allowances; checked allowances remain unresearched unless a sourced checked row is present.
audit_note: Read rendered policy: one carry-on 24x16x10 inches including attachments, plus underseat personal item. No numeric personal box or cabin weight stated. Stored exact cm conversion, not rounded-up placeholder. Legacy two-free-checked-bags claim removed; current fees depend on fare/date/status. Shared-weight groups, linear constraints, aircraft and entitlement exceptions require further engine/publication review. Strictness and sizer measurements were not verified in this audit.
